recommendation_summary: Do now: sort the existing shared list by pickup date with earliest first, bake from the top, never start a later date while an earlier one is unmade, and do a quick morning check that every order due today is in progress or done. No optional additions. The reply recommends postponing or cancelling the Odoo implementation partner. It also offers to set up the sort and today view once the user says which app holds the list. Nothing the user needs is left unaddressed.

note: The reply picks a bounded fix: sort the existing list by pickup date and add a morning check. It rejects Odoo by name and grounds its claims only in facts the user supplied.
